title: Hearty Lentil Stew
description: A flavorful, comforting stew made with red lentils and aromatic spices. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the Tunisian aromatic spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Check the lentils for tenderness. If they're still firm, continue to simmer for another 15-30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
